hmda.source: Committed HMDA New Jersey slice (data/hmda/new-jersey/county_market_summary_nj.csv), Middlesex County row. Properties located in Middlesex County. Not a second national download.
hmda.caveat: HMDA describes reporting institutions in the statutory HMDA universe for properties located in this county. It does not describe all lending activity. Denial rate is denials divided by applications. It is not a quality score, approval probability, or fair-lending conclusion. Disparity does not prove discrimination.

njhmfa.copy: Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000).
njhmfa.caveat: County of the property does not by itself qualify a borrower. Amounts are 'up to' and require program eligibility. NJHMFA participation is not an endorsement.

land_records.copy: The official SearchNG index covers deeds from 1929, mortgages from 1950, and other recorded documents from 1958. The Clerk cannot perform a title search. A recorded mortgage is not a current loan balance.

sheriff.source_name: CivilView SalesWeb foreclosure listing (Middlesex County Sheriff)
semantics: Scheduled is not a completed sale.
Adjourned is not a completed sale.
Bankruptcy is not a completed sale.
Redeemed is not a completed sheriff sale.
Purchased - 3rd Party is the completed-sale status on this listing.
CivilView is a public summary listing, not an official record of title.
sheriff.copy: On the 2026-09-03 CivilView snapshot, 175 listings were present: 72 scheduled, 43 Purchased - 3rd Party (the listing's completed-sale status), 53 adjourned, 5 redeemed, and 2 bankruptcy-related. Scheduled, adjourned, redeemed, and bankruptcy statuses are not completed sales. Defendant names and property addresses are not published here.

property.source_name: NJGIN Parcels and MOD-IV Composite of NJ (Web Mercator), COUNTY='MIDDLESEX' filter
property.daniels_law: OWNER_NAME is redacted on the public web service per Daniel's Law. This page does not publish owner names.
property.copy: NJGIN reports 243,019 parcel/MOD-IV features in Middlesex County. Parcel count is not a housing-unit or household count. Assessment value is not appraised market value. Owner names are not shown. County zoning and site-incentive overlays were not published as a zoning product.

findings.title: 2025 mortgage application mix
findings.body: The committed 2025 HMDA county slice recorded 26,149 applications, 14,147 originations, and 4,782 denials for properties in Middlesex County (18.29% denial rate, denials ÷ applications). Purchase applications were 37.33% of applications and refinance applications were 35.32%. Conventional applications were 87.47% of the county mix, with FHA 10.22%, VA 2.24%, and USDA/other 0.07%. Denial rate is not a quality score.

findings.title: NJHMFA down-payment geography
findings.body: Middlesex is in NJHMFA's 12-county group. Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000). County of the property does not by itself establish borrower eligibility.

lender_discovery.copy: Use the New Jersey lender catalog and the existing Middlesex County catalog page to research lenders. A headquarters or city listed in this county does not mean the lender serves only this county. HMDA county activity is not a New Jersey license roster. Individual mortgage loan originators are not published from this page.
